principle: A report, worker exit, single failed attempt, or rejected candidate is not department-goal completion.

success_criteria: durable source-backed finding or qualified handoff exists
provenance and uncertainty are persisted
open questions have a next query or reasoned disposition
customer problem and demand evidence are recorded
business model alternatives and economics are assessed
minimum viable test and measurable success criteria are defined
candidate advances with evidence or is rejected while discovery goal remains active
source-derived and Nexus-designed rules are separately attributed
testable candidates complete bounded backtest and robustness evaluation
paper progression is separately authorized and evidenced
target audience, positioning, offer and channel hypothesis are recorded
funnel/content requirements and measurement plan exist
appropriate Creative handoff is owned or a next action is persisted
usable asset exists
critique and required revisions are recorded
provider failure or rejected variant has an alternate route or next revision
bounded experiment includes hypothesis and success criteria
result and lesson are persisted
failed experiment has a next experiment or evidence-based disproval
promotion decision cites verification evidence
rejection records reason, required repair and next validation
approved promotion is routed to Systems for controlled application
incident is diagnosed
safe repair or fallback is applied
restored capability is verified
remaining human-only action is exact and has a resume stage
